title: Cardinality of a binary subspace
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $A$ be a linear subspace of the $n$-dimensional vector space over the field with two elements. Then the number of elements of $A$ is $2^{\dim A}$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a subspace of the $n$-dimensional vector space over the two-element field
